testCases.title: Verify Accessibility of Contact Form
expectedResults: The contact form is displayed on the page.

testCases.title: Verify Required Fields in Contact Form
steps: Check the contact form for required fields.
expectedResults: All required fields are displayed in the contact form.

testCases.title: Verify Subject Dropdown Options
steps: Open the subject dropdown in the contact form.
expectedResults: The subject dropdown contains the specified options.

testCases.title: Verify Validation Error for Short Message
steps: Enter a message with fewer than 50 characters into the message field.
expectedResults: A validation error is shown indicating the message must be at least 50 characters.
